He explores the wild yet beautiful landscape of the Land's End peninsula with the artist Kurt Jackson, before heading to the tranquillity of an heritage apple orchard preserved by head gardener John Harris. Here Rick picks some apples to make his mother's Apple Charlotte pudding.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall

In the fishing village of Mevagissey, he discovers the origins of the sea shanty and the history of the pilchard fishing industry, when shoals of pilchards were so large they would attract killer whales.

programme.title: Robson Green's Weekend Escapes

Noel Fielding and Jamali Maddix are joined by The Vamps' Bradley Simpson. The teams tackle absurd boy and girl band trivia and must identify Girl Thang and Irish boyband D-Side in the ID Parade. Plus, there's a special look at Aerosmith's Steven Tyler and his infamously odd feet. Expect laughs, chaos, and plenty of pop nostalgia.

programme.title: SBS World News Late

programme.title: Sambre: Anatomy Of A Crime

Inside the station, a pattern is beginning to form, but those who could act are choosing to look the other way.

Directed by Gurinder Chadra and stars Hugh Bonneville, Gillian Anderson and Michael Gambon.
